messages:
zoe (PM): quick thread: proposal for 'gradual degrade' autofallback UX. aim: make it auditable and operator-friendly without spamming them.
dave (Infra): +1. runtime can do staged shifts (5% -> 25% -> 100%). need events for each step.
ev an (Eng): typo: evan (Eng): runtime event should include step_pct, trigger_reason, window_secs, metrics_snapshot. keep it tiny.
priya (SRE): triggers: prefer composite rules. e.g., sustained p95 > T AND 5xx_rate_inc > X across 3m. also require min duration before next step.
marta (Design): UX: dashboard card says "Gradual fallback in progress: 5% -> small-model (latency)" with a mini-timeline. expand shows steps with timestamps.
zoe (PM): plus a suggested operator action: "Promote suggested rollout" or "Pause further steps". both should append an audit entry.
dave (Infra): add API: POST /autofallbacks/{id}/action {action:pause|promote|revert, reason, dry_run}. must create operator_audit entries.
ev an (Eng): about samples: surface up to 2 failed items per step, redacted. sampling rate: 1/sample/min/route. scrub keys that look like emails, tokens.
priya (SRE): paging: only page if degrade reaches >=50% and persists >10m for enterprise; otherwise slack banner + console. keep an aggregated metric: gradual_fallback_progress_by_route.
marta (Design): inspection panel: each step row shows step pct, trigger metric, a tiny sparkline, and a "view sample" that opens a scrubbed sample modal. also show "why this fired" raw numbers.
zoe (PM): audit detail should include model_checksum, runtime_build, kernel_variant, candidate_model, and the exact trigger payload. searchable in audit log.
ev an (Eng): we'll emit compact events for steps. control plane will create a read-only rollout draft that operators can promote. also rate-limit whole process: no more than 1 gradual-degrade per route per 30m.
priya (SRE): add hysteresis: if metrics recover, rollback steps automatically but log each revert. require 2m stable window before re-promoting.
dave (Infra): I'll stub the API and audit entry format.
marta (Design): will wire a mock for the card + timeline and share by EOD.
zoe (PM): thanks. action items: evan: event spec; priya: runbook and thresholds; marta: mock; dave: API stub. I'll update RFC and tag folks.
